Lake Nyos didn't explode with water or fire.
Lake Nyos released 100,000 to 300,000 tons of carbon dioxide.

Deep lake water can hold dissolved CO2 under pressure.
Villagers below had no warning and nothing to breathe.
It would not all happen at once.
A degassing system has since been installed at the lake.

Once mixed upward, the gas fizzed out of solution.
Pipes now vent the gas slowly to prevent a repeat.

script.spoken: A lake once exploded and killed 1,746 people. It didn't burst with water. It burst with CO2. Lake Nyos released 100,000 to 300,000 tons of carbon dioxide. Its deep water was supersaturated, like a shaken soda. Once mixed upward, the gas fizzed out of solution. CO2 is 50% denser than air, so the cloud hugged valleys. Villagers below had no warning and nothing to breathe. Pipes now vent the gas slowly to prevent a repeat.
